subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Twitter Bitcoin Hack
description: One-minute skill: The Twitter Bitcoin Hack.

hook.text: In July 2020, tweets from Obama, Musk, and Gates offered to double any Bitcoin sent to them.

buildup.text: Hackers had taken over Twitter's internal admin tools by social-engineering a few employees.

discovery.text: The scam collected over $120,000 in Bitcoin within hours before Twitter locked down all accounts.

twist.text: The mastermind was a 17-year-old from Florida. He was arrested within two weeks.

climax.text: The hack exposed that a few Twitter employees could control any account on the platform.

punchline.text: A teenager hijacked Twitter with a phone call.

quiz.question: How did hackers gain access to Twitter's admin tools?
